newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 300 MW peak firm power Thurs, prices up.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 300 MW peak firm power Thurs, prices up.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) continued to offer 300 megawatts of peak firm power for next-day delivery, but raised prices by $2.00 a megawatt hour (MWh) from Tuesday, the agency said Wednesday.
BPA offered peak power during hours ending 0700-2200 PDT on Thursday at $24.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest sales and at $27.00 for California-Oregon border sales.
The agency continued to offer off-peak firm power at $9.00 on Thursday for all deliveries.
BPA prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0600 and 2300 PDT on Thursday were also unchanged at $10.00 per MWh, while prices for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT were flat at $9.00 per MWh.
